BFA.note: Two data centres are named only as nodes of the government network RESINA, not as renting to others.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition said it drafted and adopted a decree on universal access to electronic communications to strengthen the universal service fund and cover white zones, and drafted the fund's strategic plan.
The Ministry of Digital Transition said it drafted an avant-projet de loi on basic identification in Burkina Faso in 2023.

BFA.note: Document names PACTDIGITAL, a financed programme, and no national strategy.
The PACTDIGITAL financing is a World Bank loan; no state budget line is stated.
The subscriber identification decree is stated without a check against the national ID.
No data centre for hire is stated.
Document gives no rural electricity figure.
